findings.title: Archive limits must bound actual acquisition and physical copying
findings.established: bounded_inventory accounts the enumerated st_size, then discards the metadata returned by the later custodied acquisition. A file may grow before that acquisition and present a stable larger image. The individual read remains capped, but aggregate acquired bytes can exceed maximumArchiveBytes without rejection. copy_tree then invokes the unchanged source06 stream copier without a physical byte budget; destination bounds and equality run only after the copy.
evidence: targeted-results.json: metadata-growth-before-custodied-read; actual bounded_inventory accepted 16 acquired body bytes under synthetic total cap 10, with stable same-inode growth before acquisition
targeted-results.json: source-growth-at-legacy-copyfileobj; actual copy_tree and source06 copy functions wrote 482513 archive bytes under synthetic total cap 482424 before ARCHIVE_TOTAL_BYTE_CAP
Independent QA communicated a separate actual-function fake case exceeding its scaled per-file cap before destination rejection; no actual archive was created
findings.requiredCorrection: Enforce the remaining aggregate and per-file budgets on the actual opened acquisition before collecting bodies, account the consumed metadata and actual acquired length, and bound physical copying as it occurs. Preserve exact old source06 bytes; implement the correction in the new subject adapter rather than modifying the frozen helper. Later inventory/equality rejection remains necessary but does not substitute for limits before acquisition/copy.

findings.title: Prequalification failure must forward closed typed ownership metadata
findings.established: Before qualification, capture records UNKNOWN_CURRENT_UTILITY and retains the child and Unit references in pending/UNRESOLVED without writing N. If qualification fails on the first utility timeout, run finally calls close, which retains only those in-process references. The outer guard exports only status, errorType, and credit before interpreter exit. The captured child PID, exact requested command/binary binding, client qualification state, and partial completion facts are not forwarded to durable separately captured disposition evidence.
evidence: Independent QA communicated its actual run('negative') -> constructor/register/table/capture fake-timeout case: child PID known, UNKNOWN_CURRENT_UTILITY, pending nonempty, prequalified false, and zero new N files
Independent Aria source inspection confirms the pending/UNRESOLVED retention and the exact outer guard failure output; no actual guard callback or process-exit/orphan observation is claimed
findings.requiredCorrection: Provide an exact reviewed failure path that forwards closed typed client/child ownership and partial-completion metadata to separately captured evidence outside the unqualified N namespace before exit. Keep the no-write-before-qualification rule, UNKNOWN/HOLD classification, one-shot consumption, and separate disposition requirement. Do not infer a child start, completion, absence, cleanup authority, or permission to retry.
